cards.description: Black in Informatics is a community-driven organization dedicated to fostering the professional, academic, and personal development of Black students within the Informatics program. Its mission is to amplify the presence and successes of Black students in Informatics, guiding them throughout their journey at UW with resources, mentorship, and specialized learning experiences.

CPT serves as a work authorization as students engage in different types of activities related to their major.

cards.description: At the University of Washington, diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are integral to excellence. We value and honor diverse identities, experiences, and perspectives, strive to create accessible, welcoming, and respectful learning environments, and promote access, opportunity, and justice for all.

cards.description: Your launchpad for tech teamwork @ the UW. Husky Coding Project is a student organization at University of Washington that aims to provide a space for students, regardless of major or background, to gain group project work experience within the tech field.

cards.name: Husky Health & Well-Being
bullets: A wide range of health and wellness services at UW Seattle, including medical care and counseling
Recreation classes, safety resources, peer health advocacy, trainings, and more
Most services are limited to currently enrolled UW Seattle students, and some are open to faculty, staff, and the general public
cards.description: UW Seattle offers a wide range of health and wellness services, from exceptional medical care and counseling services to recreation classes, safety resources, peer health advocacy, trainings and more. Most services on this site are limited to currently enrolled UW Seattle students, while others are open to faculty, staff and the general public.

cards.name: iMentorship
bullets: Work closely, one-on-one, with an information professional as you pursue your professional dreams
They can provide insight, guidance, and support, and help you jumpstart a professional network
For students in the BS in Informatics and Master of Science in Information Management (MSIM) programs
cards.description: The mission of the iMentorship Program is to support students in the iSchool’s Bachelor of Science in Informatics and Master of Science in Information Management (MSIM) programs as they pursue their professional dreams by enabling each student to work closely, one-on-one, with an information professional who can provide insight, guidance and support, and can help the student jumpstart a professional network.

cards.name: iMuslims
bullets: Student-led resources and community to help Muslim students at the iSchool thrive at UW and beyond
Empowers students to be information and technology leaders through events that promote connection, establish networks, and build professional skills
All students are welcome at events, and you can keep up with the org on Instagram @imuslims.uw
cards.description: iMuslims is a student-led organization dedicated to providing Muslim students at the iSchool with resources and community that will allow them to thrive at UW and beyond. We empower students to be information and technology leaders by promoting connection, establishing networks, and building professional skills through event programming. All students are welcome at our events — you can keep up with our org by following us on Instagram @imuslims.uw.

cards.name: iQueeries
bullets: Safe, positive, and nurturing space for LGBTQIA+ and supportive ally students in the iSchool
Fosters a strong, supportive queer community in the iSchool and UW at large, and promotes positive change and social justice in the information sciences
iQueeries is intersectional, and all identities and experiences are welcome and encouraged to share their voices
cards.description: iQueeries provides a safe, positive, and nurturing space for LGBTQIA+ and supportive ally students in the Information School. It works to foster a strong, supportive queer community within the iSchool as well as UW at large, and to promote positive change and social justice within the field of information sciences. iQueeries is intersectional: all identities and experiences are welcome and encouraged to share their voices.

cards.name: ISACA
bullets: For students interested in learning about information security and risk
Workshops and events on basic information security procedures and best practices
cards.description: ISACA aims to engage students who are interested in learning about information security and risk. This student group accomplishes this by hosting workshops and events that teach students about basic information security procedures and best practices.

cards.name: iSchool Career Services (Canvas)

cards.description: The iSchool Career Services team is excited to help support you in meeting your professional development goals and navigating the job search process. Our team provides one-on-one advising, help with job search strategies and specific opportunities, resume and cover letter feedback, and interview advice and practice.

Advising hours and scheduling instructions are listed below for graduate admissions, academic and career advisors. Most programs host appointments online or in-person.
